briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push multi-agent capabilities beyond 2025 benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier intensified in Q3 2026 with record model releases and compute deployments. Major labs accelerate toward AGI while regulatory pressure mounts on safety. DialectForge emerges as a key protocol innovation in secure multi-agent systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with 2.1T parameters achieving 94% on MMLU-Pro. Anthropic's Claude 4 and DeepSeek R2 launched within days. Meta's Llama 4 open weights triggered rapid downstream fine-tunes.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across automotive, IoT and BCI domains.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell clusters reached 1M GPU scale at xAI Memphis site. Microsoft and Google announced 2027 data center expansions exceeding 50GW combined. TSMC 2nm yields improved 18% for AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first model to pass the 95th percentile on GAIA benchmark trigger coordinated global safety pauses?
